summary: Tests-only red phase for issue #5 (generated OpenAPI Swift client). Wrote three permanent unit-level test files and two LID docs. OpenAPISpecCoverageTests (iOS/Tests/ColorMatchingLPSAppTests/OpenAPISpecCoverageTests.swift) compiles today and pins the vendored spec's semantic facts, which were extracted from the real published API source (viamin/color_matching#113: Router, ApiSpec, ApiSchemas, TestSheetController, CaptureController). GeneratedClientTests + OpenAPIStubTransport are intentionally compile-red until the implementation run adds the ColorMatchingAPI generated target; the missing-module error is the compile-time drift signal the migration buys. No Swift toolchain exists in this container (swift: command not found), so no tests could be executed locally; CI (macos runner) will surface the red phase. Deliverable D5 (contract deltas + endpoint gaps) is fully recorded in docs/color-matching-openapi-contract-deltas.md, derived from the actual upstream spec: manifest/ranked-results schemas are thin (gaps G1/G2), measurement upload drops stats and top-level scoring_algorithm_version, uploads return 200+JSON (not empty 2xx), judgments/rejections are not enums upstream, and four vendoring patches (P1-P4) are documented and enforced by test assertions.
